recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Patient Care, Public Health, and FHIR-I want core CarePlan to explicitly reference the Immunization Incubator resource, handle that as a new cross-artifact dependency decision rather than as a FHIR-19420 fixup.
issue_request: FHIR-19420 was Published with a Persuasive R5 resolution requesting support for CarePlan.activity.reference to Reference(ImmunizationRecommendation), because CarePlan Scope and Usage mentioned a patient due for tetanus immunization while the activity reference type did not allow ImmunizationRecommendation.
initial_application: Commit 218ec67c42b8156bcd8330a57848603b297321d3 applied the issue by adding ImmunizationRecommendation to the then-authoritative CarePlan activity reference target list in source/careplan/careplan-spreadsheet.xml and tagging the row GF#19420. Later CarePlan refactors renamed activity.reference to activity.plannedActivityReference and retained the GF#19420 note.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has careplan and immunization active but no immunizationrecommendation resource. Commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 deliberately removed ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation from core, removed ImmunizationRecommendation from CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference, and changed CarePlan boundaries prose to link to the external Immunization Incubator definition. The external package now defines ImmunizationRecommendation; a checked-in CarePlan SVG still shows it, but the authoritative StructureDefinition source controls this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding ImmunizationRecommendation to the core CarePlan targetProfile list would reverse the later out-of-core resource move and introduce a current core reference to an artifact that is outside this build.
